title: Run
description: Definitions the client protocol's run messages share: run ids, what perform is asked to run, a run's summary as status and logs report it, and one recorded run event.

runId.title: Run id
runId.description: A UUID in canonical lowercase form, minted by perform.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Where a run works: its own worktree, or the theatre itself, as its start recorded it, with a worktree's clone mechanisms once it is made.

worktreeWorkspace.title: In its own worktree
worktreeWorkspace.description: A run that works in its own git worktree: what its start recorded, and the clone mechanisms its Run.WorktreeMade recorded.

prefix.description: Where the theatre is in its repository, such as apps/web/, when it isn't the top level. Absent: the theatre is the repository's top level.

builtOn.description: The run of the flow's step before, whose work so far the worktree was built on. Absent: the run is its performance's first step, or a single actor's run.

clones.description: The clone mechanisms used for the files that matched HEAD, sorted. Absent: the worktree isn't made yet.

runRef.title: Run reference
runRef.description: A run's full id, or a prefix of at least 8 hex digits that matches exactly one run.

actorName.title: Actor name
actorName.description: The actor's name. It becomes the agent's id in lineage.

runnerName.title: Runner name
runnerName.description: A runner troupe knows by name. A request never carries a command line.

theatrePath.title: Theatre-relative path
theatrePath.description: A path relative to the theatre's root, with / separators. Never a host path, a drive, or a path that leaves the theatre with ..

effectCheck.title: Effect check
effectCheck.description: How troupe checks, after a run, that it did what it was for. There is no default: none must be said explicitly.

paths.description: Each file must exist after the run, and differ from before it.

state.title: State
state.description: Derived, never recorded: ended (its end is recorded), running (its perform is alive in this clone), interrupted (its perform has gone without recording an end), or unfinished-elsewhere (it was started in another clone, so this clone can't tell).

performanceId.description: The performance the run is a step of.

step.description: The run's step in its performance, counting from 1.

actorNow.description: The actor's name now, when it has been renamed since the run (config mv, or files moved by hand), following every rename. Absent: the actor has its name still, or no longer exists.

reported.description: The runner's name and version from its init event, the run's first reported event. Absent: it sent none.

workspace.description: Where the run works: its own worktree, or the theatre. A worktree's clones are absent until it is made.

outcome.description: How the run ended. Present exactly when state is ended.

error.description: Why the run didn't succeed, from the run's end. Only when state is ended. Absent: the outcome has no error, or the run hasn't ended.

audit.description: What the audit of the run's changes against its actor's declared effects found, as its end recorded it. Present exactly when the run has ended and its runner started, that is when an ended run's summary has a transcript.

events.description: How many run events are recorded.

endedAt.description: When the run's end was recorded. Present exactly when state is ended.

transcript.description: The transcript's artifact reference, from the run's end. Only when state is ended. Absent: the run hasn't ended, or its runner never started.

transcriptFormat.description: How the transcript's lines are written, as the run's end recorded it: native (each line a record as the runner sent it) or kinds (each line a record with its kind, transcript-record.schema.json). Present exactly when transcript is.

stderr.description: The artifact reference of the runner's standard error, from the run's end. Only when state is ended. Absent: the run hasn't ended, or its runner never started.

recording.description: What wasn't recorded first, and why: the first run event, by its seq, or a notice troupe raised for the run, by its code, as the run's end recorded it. Only when state is ended. Absent: recording didn't fail, or the run hasn't ended.

notices.description: The notices troupe raised for the run and recorded in its history, in recorded order, each with when it was recorded. Absent: the run recorded none.

changes.description: What a worktree run changed, and what has been done with it. Present exactly when the workspace is a worktree.

usage.description: The tokens the run used, exactly as its recorded result carries them. Absent: no result is recorded yet, or the result carried no usage.

cost.description: What the run cost, from its recorded result. Absent: no result is recorded yet, or the result carried no cost.

approvers.description: The approvers the run's gate tries, in order, as its start recorded them. Present exactly when the workspace is a worktree.

gate.description: What happened at the run's gate, in the order it was recorded: a pass, a cue, and the answer that kept or rejected its changes. Absent: nothing has happened at its gate.

role.title: Role
role.description: A role a gate's approver holds: troupe, troupe's own automatic approver, or director, held by whoever runs troupe until roles config says who holds it.

approvers.title: Approvers
approvers.description: A worktree run's approvers, in the order its gate tries them, and where they came from: step when a flow's step sets them, actor when the actor's approvers set them, default when they're troupe's built-in troupe, director.

gateStep.title: A gate step
gateStep.description: One thing that happened at a run's gate.

step.description: An approver couldn't act and passed the gate on.

files.description: The files that don't apply to the working tree.

step.description: A cue was raised for a role a person holds.
approved: the role let the changes through, keeping them or, between a flow's steps, letting them go on. rejected: the role removed them.

actor.description: Who answered: troupe itself (system), or a person.

reason.description: Why, in the answerer's words. Absent: none was given.

changes.title: A run's changes
changes.description: A worktree run's changes. state: waiting (a cue for them is open at the run's gate), pending (captured, with no gate and not yet accepted or discarded), approved (a flow's step let through its gate, its work gone on to the next step), accepted, discarded, rejected (at the gate), none (the run changed nothing) or uncaptured (the run was interrupted, or capturing failed). The worktree is kept until the changes are accepted, discarded or rejected.

cue.description: The open cue the changes wait for. Present exactly when state is waiting.

diff.description: The diff's artifact reference. Present exactly when the run's end recorded one.

sofar.description: The performance's diff so far, through this step, as its run's end recorded it: what a flow's last gate lands. Absent: the run is its performance's only or first step, or nothing has changed so far.

added.description: How many files the diff adds. Absent: nothing was captured.

modified.description: How many files the diff modifies. Absent: nothing was captured.

deleted.description: How many files the diff deletes. Absent: nothing was captured.

leftOut.description: How many changed paths under .troupe/ were left out of the diff. Absent: nothing was captured.

shared.description: What changed in the repository's shared state during the run, which discarding doesn't undo. Absent: nothing did, or nothing was captured.

error.description: Why the changes couldn't be captured. Absent: they were, or the run was interrupted.

files.description: The files keeping the changes changed, relative to the repository's top level. Absent: they weren't accepted.

settledAt.description: When they were accepted, discarded or rejected. Present exactly when state is one of those.

worktree.description: The worktree, relative to the theatre, while it is kept. Absent once the changes are accepted, discarded or rejected.

loggedEvent.title: Logged run event
loggedEvent.description: One run event as it was recorded: the runner's event, or troupe's oversized stand-in for it, and when troupe recorded it.

cost.title: Run cost
cost.description: What a run cost in US dollars, and which kind of figure it is: reported, the result's costUsd, as the engine or its service reported it; estimated, the result's estimatedCostUsd, worked out from the price troupe gave the runner.

runNotice.title: Recorded run notice
runNotice.description: A notice troupe raised for a run, as its history recorded it, and when.

loggedNotice.title: Logged run notice
loggedNotice.description: A notice troupe raised for a run and recorded in its history, in its place among the run's events, and when troupe recorded it. It has no seq: seq numbers only the runner's events. Its kind isn't notice, which marks the notices a query sends itself, outside the run's history.
